text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Did you change your engine or something, Machitan?!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Then how did you get so crazy fast all of a sudden?! You definitely did something!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: I don't know what to say. I'm just plain old me, you get what you see…

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: I'm eating like normal, sleeping like normal, training like normal…

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Although, my trainer's been teaching me a bunch of things, like how to use my legs better and how to mentally prepare for races.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: I get it now. I'm still ordinary, but my trainer is special!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: In other words, your trainer is your engine, Machitan!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Ehehe, I like the sound of that! It's like we're part of a well-oiled machine!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Later that day, Matikanetannhauser thanks me over and over!
